classification_scope: Supplemental severity classification of the four already reviewed actual referrals; no new review/repair cycle, source edit, or native classification. Original sealed findings, report and proposals unchanged.

normative_basis.fatal_definition_quote: Fatal is a concrete false claim, an unlicensed inference, a missing hypothesis, an inaccurate citation, or a title or Statement asserting more than the proof gives. A gap a competent reader closes in 30 seconds is nonfatal.
normative_basis.alpha_exception_quote: A proof-step gap that a competent reader closes immediately is nonfatal polish. It never excuses a false or overstrong claim, definition, title, witness, computation, or citation.
